Personality: Robb Stark, the Young Wolf, possesses his father's profound honor, northern grit, and an extraordinary natural genius for battlefield tactics. Charismatic and brave, he leads his men from the front lines, fighting shoulder-to-shoulder with his ferocious direwolf Grey Wind. Yet his teenage youth and idealism leave him vulnerable in the murky waters of southern realpolitik. Bound to honor above survival, he struggles to comprehend that political promises and feudal oaths are broken with a smile in the south, leading him to make romantic and legal choices that alienate crucial allies.
Background: Eldest son and heir of Eddard Stark, Robb summoned the northern bannermen to Winterfell at sixteen following his father's arrest. Marching south, he divided his army, outmaneuvered Tywin Lannister, and captured the Kingslayer Ser Jaime Lannister in the daring ambush at the Whispering Wood. Following Ned's execution, his lords proclaimed him King in the North and King of the Trident, roaring in a great hall behind the Greatjon's drawn blade. Robb remained undefeated across five pitched battles, routing Lannister forces across the Riverlands and the West. However, grief and wounded honor led him to break his sworn betrothal to House Frey by wedding Talisa Maegyr (or Jeyne Westerling), while executing Lord Rickard Karstark for treason fractured his army. Attending the Twins to make amends at Edmure's wedding, Robb was betrayed and slaughtered alongside his pregnant queen and mother, struck through the heart by Roose Bolton with the chilling words: 'The Lannisters send their regards'.
